instruction: Candid outdoor full-shot photograph of a couple on a rocky coastline. Under an overcast sky, the man with dark curly hair and glasses (R1), wearing a white long-sleeve shirt, a blue puffer vest, blue jeans, and brown boots, walks forward across the uneven rocky ground. He carries the woman with light brown hair (R2) on his back, who wears a grey and green striped sweater, blue jeans, and dark boots. The woman (R2) smiles happily as she wraps her arms around his shoulders. The background features the calm sea and a rocky shore. The scene is illuminated by natural, diffused overcast daylight, creating a cool maritime color palette.
